body: net/http's Transport calls DialContext with a context of its own that does not carry the request's deadline (seen on Go 1.26 in upload/proxy.go): anything a custom dialer does after connecting (a CONNECT exchange, a handshake) must set its own conn deadline, or a silent peer holds the dial. Found 2026-10-09 when the coverage of the ctx.Deadline branch in FetchOptions.connect stayed at zero even with a 5 s request timeout.
